summary: The unconditional bin-weight reduction and both explicitly conditional consequences are established without mathematical errors or gaps. The lattice-difference argument gives the two opposite unit gaps with boundary equality allowed, which justifies the injective antichain representation and the local bound of one. The weighted consecutive-rank coupling has the required marginals and increment support; the subsequent rank-weight estimate proves the bound by max{1,Q}. The geometric-law normalization, both inclusive cutoffs, independence across blocks, strict inequality for Q at most one, and the exact constant 3391/3456 all check out. No vertex integrality, factorwise lattice splitting, or unproved scalar probability inequality is used as an unconditional premise.
